title: Garry's Mod
provenance: Reported by phmuni (highball-db#120, 2026-09-18): rated 4, playable with minor issues, on DXMT, Apple M5, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, Highball 0.9.23, 58 minutes played through Highball. Not run here.
notes: Source engine, Direct3D 9. Boots and plays fine at the display's native resolution in the one report, completely playable over a near-hour session. Two things noted: it crashed once while creating a world for the first time and was fine after a restart, and motion feels a little jittery, not a true 120 Hz feel, even though the game itself runs well. Frame rate not measured.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashed once while creating a world for the first time (M5, macOS 27, DXMT)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; the reporter thinks it was a one-off
knownIssues.fix: Start the game again, it went fine on the second try

knownIssues.symptom: Motion feels slightly jittery and not a true 120 Hz, though performance is good
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; reads like a frame pacing issue rather than raw frame rate
knownIssues.fix: none recorded yet; the game stays fully playable
